title: Lab - Custom Resource Definitions
description: Define a new kind and create one.
scenario: Define a new kind and create one. This lab is a skeleton: the tasks name what to do and how to check it; work them on your own cluster and expand your notes as you go.
environment_setup:
# A three-node kind cluster is enough for this lab
cat <<'EOF' > kind-cka.yaml
kind: Cluster
apiVersion: kind.x-k8s.io/v1alpha4
name: cka
nodes:
  - role: control-plane
  - role: worker
  - role: worker
EOF
kind create cluster --config kind-cka.yaml
kubectl get nodes
cleanup:
kind delete cluster --name cka
rm -f kind-cka.yaml

tasks.title: Task 1 - Inspect
tasks.instructions: Which CRDs already exist in the cluster?

tasks.title: Task 2 - Create a CRD
tasks.instructions: Create CRD internals.datasets.kodekloud.com with a Namespaced scope and an openAPI schema for spec.internalLoad (string) and spec.range (integer).

tasks.title: Task 3 - Create an object
tasks.instructions: Create an Internal object named internal-space with range 80.
